findings.summary: Account's description now says it stores the daily reminder's local hour, but the diff adds no matching field to Account; only NotificationJob gains a localHour field, so the chosen hour has no persistent home on the owner record.
findings.evidence: description: ID, identity-provider subject, display name, time zone and notification preferences, including the local hour of the daily reminder ... (fields unchanged; only '+ { name: localHour, type: int }' added under NotificationJob)

findings.summary: NotificationPreferences is now described as where the owner sets the reminder opt-in and local hour, but its only link is 'reads' to Account, so nothing in the model persists the owner's choice.
findings.evidence: description: External reminder opt-in and the local hour at which the daily reminder is sent ... links: - { rel: reads, to: entity.Account }
